story: phStaging2 story-100 (Balancexit Stage 2 core); plan docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md section 4

executionModel.summary: No storage, no external entry points. `_runCutover(CutoverParams)` (L242) runs steps 0..12 from the INHERITING contract's context: under `vm.startBroadcast(OWNER)` every external call below becomes a separate OWNER-EOA transaction. The core's own `require`s execute in forge's local simulation pass only; they are NOT on-chain guards for a mainnet broadcast.
executionModel.status: VERIFIED (L50-53 NatSpec + no on-chain contract deployed for the orchestration itself; only `new UniPoolerV2` at L353)
onChainGuardsActuallyEnforced: Balancer V3 Router/Vault: minAmountsOut per token (step 5, L382-385)
Uniswap V2 Router02: amountAMin/amountBMin = recovered*(1-seedTol) and deadline = p.seedDeadline (step 6, L429-430)
Callee access control (onlyOwner on old pooler / hook / NFTMinter / new pooler; onlyOwnerOrRecipient on hook.pull)
UniPoolerV2 constructor: pair token set + canonical-pair check (yield-claim-nft UniPoolerV2.sol L215-221)

sequence.checks: owner owns old pooler, hook, NFT minter; tolerances <= 100 bps; seedDeadline in (now, now+1d]; every p.poolers[i] non-zero and fails old.onlyAuthorizedPooler (poolerAuthVersion != authVersion); configs(index).dispatcher == oldPooler; hook.dispatcher == oldPooler; old.hook == mintDebtHook; live reads sUSDS/USDS(primeToken)/phUSD(hook.phUSD)/bPool/bVault/factory non-zero; Balancer pool tokens == {sUSDS, phUSD} (2 tokens, either order); minAmountsOut.length == 2 and each > 0

sequence.mutates: UniV2 factory: createPair(sUSDS, phUSD) iff getPair == 0 (permissionless call; anyone may have created it first, reused)
pair.skim(p.owner) iff pair holds sUSDS or phUSD balance with zero reserves
sequence.checks: reserves (0,0) before and after; balances (0,0) after. A SYNCED donation (non-zero reserves) reverts here (simulation) - griefable DoS, see run-39 L-01
sequence.note: skim destination is OWNER here; the escrow (yield-claim-nft) skims to newPooler instead

sequence.mutates: CREATE UniPoolerV2(sUSDS, phUSD, uniV2Router, pair, owner) from the broadcaster
old.withdrawBPT(OWNER, fullBalance): BPT custody moves to the OWNER EOA
OWNER: BPT.approve(balancerRouter, bptIn) then removeLiquidityProportional|removeLiquidityRecovery(bPool, bptIn, minAmountsOut). sUSDS + phUSD land on OWNER EOA
sequence.checks: bptIn = OWNER's WHOLE BPT balance (includes OWNER's own pre-existing BPT, not only what step 4 withdrew); `_checkMinAmountsOut` (L396) requires share*(1-exitTol) <= minAmountsOut[i] <= share where share = balancesRaw[i]*bptIn/totalSupply (live, simulation-time); after: OWNER BPT == 0; sOut/pOut measured as OWNER balance deltas, both > 0
sequence.approvalHygiene: approve to Balancer Router is exact and fully consumed by the burn; not reset (ASSUMED fully spent - mainnet Router burns exactly exactBptAmountIn)

sequence.mutates: OWNER: approve sUSDS/phUSD to Router02 (exact), addLiquidity(sUSDS, phUSD, sAmt, pAmt, sMin, pMin, to=newPooler, seedDeadline). LP minted to UniPoolerV2
sequence.checks: a == sAmt && b == pAmt; liquidity > 0; pair.balanceOf(newPooler) == liquidity; reserves == seeded amounts (all simulation-only). On-chain only the 1%-max mins bind

sequence.mutates: hook.pull(): mints mintDebt phUSD to hook.recipient (NFTStaker on mainnet), mintDebt -> 0
sequence.precondition: hook.recipient != 0 else reverts RecipientUnset; hook must hold phUSD mint rights (ASSUMED)

sequence.mutates: newPooler.setMinter(nftMinter); setPSM(old.psm) iff non-zero; setMaxTout; setBatchMinter (copied even if zero); setBatchDonationSize; setAuthorizedPooler(p.poolers[i], true); setNudgeStreamer(old.nudgeStreamer) iff non-zero (last)
sequence.note: re-authorizes exactly the caller-supplied p.poolers on the NEW pooler (the same set that step 0 proved revoked on the old one)

sequence.mutates: old.rescueERC20(sUSDS, newPooler, all). USDS: if new pooler donation is live (size>0 && batchMinter!=0 && psm!=0) rescue USDS straight to newPooler; else rescue to OWNER, OWNER approve sUSDS + sUSDS.deposit(usds, newPooler)

sequence.checks: index on newPooler; hook on newPooler; BPT == 0 on old pooler AND on OWNER; old pooler sUSDS/USDS == 0; old paused

noUnboundedLoops.note: loops over p.poolers (caller input) and 2 pool tokens

checkedArithmetic.note: 0.8.x; no unchecked/assembly. `_totalSupply` uses low-level staticcall with length check (L410-414)

verifiedProperties.accessControlled: N/A - internal-only abstract contract; authority is the broadcaster's ownership of old pooler / hook / NFT minter (step 0)

fundsLeaveProtocolCustody.note: Between step 4 and step 6 the BPT, then the recovered sUSDS+phUSD, sit on the OWNER EOA across separate transactions; in the no-donation branch of step 11 the parked USDS also transits OWNER. The UniPoolerCutoverEscrow (yield-claim-nft story-052) exists to remove exactly this, but this core does not reference it

seedUsesDeltasNotWholeBalance.note: step 6 seeds only the step-5 OWNER balance deltas; the escrow seeds whole balances - the two designs differ

idempotentOrResumable.note: no resume/progress logic: a partial broadcast leaves state that step 0 rejects on re-run (e.g. after step 8 hook.dispatcher != oldPooler; after step 4 BPT on OWNER is still handled by step 5 but step 3 would deploy a second UniPoolerV2). Plan section text L414 says the operator re-runs 'from step 6 with a reviewed recovery' - no such entry point exists in this core

callerSupplied: balancerRouter (not exposed by BalancerPoolerV2, so unverifiable on-chain against the pooler)
readLive: bPool = old.pool() (MUTABLE on old pooler via setPool)

externalCalls.trustLevel: semi-trusted external (governance can pause; 30 Oct pools paused, 30 Nov vault paused per plan)
semi-trusted external; address NOT cross-checked against anything on-chain
semi-trusted immutable; the PAIR's state is attacker-influenceable (anyone can transfer tokens to it, sync, or mint LP once it exists)

custody.holdsTokens: none (abstract script code). Custody during the run, in order: BPT old pooler -> OWNER EOA (step 4) -> burned via Router (step 5); sUSDS+phUSD Balancer vault -> OWNER EOA (step 5) -> pair (step 6); LP -> UniPoolerV2; old-pooler sUSDS -> UniPoolerV2 (step 11); old-pooler USDS -> UniPoolerV2 or OWNER -> sUSDS -> UniPoolerV2 (step 11); skimmed donation -> OWNER (step 2)

crossTransactionWindows.exposure: pair exists, empty and public: anyone can mint first LP / donate+sync (2-wei poisoning, run-39 L-01) or donate unsynced (skimmed in step 2 only if before step 2)
BPT then sUSDS/phUSD held by OWNER EOA; Balancer pool composition can be moved by swaps before the exit (pre-30-Oct); exit floors are minAmountsOut only

crossTransactionWindows.between: step 8 (hook -> new pooler) and step 10 (index -> new pooler)
crossTransactionWindows.exposure: index-4 mints still dispatch to the OLD pooler, whose ATokenDispatcherV2.dispatch calls hook.onDispatch, which now reverts OnlyDispatcher -> every index-4 mint reverts for those blocks
index-4 mints accrue new debt on the hook (not pulled before repoint); debt is preserved on the hook, not lost
old pooler still has NFTMinter as minter until step 12 but is no longer indexed

trustAssumptions: OWNER EOA (Ledger) is the broadcaster and owns old pooler, hook and NFTMinterV2 (checked in simulation)
p.balancerRouter is the genuine Balancer V3 Router (not verified on-chain)
Balancer V3 burns the caller's BPT by spending the ROUTER's BPT allowance (NatSpec L59-61; ASSUMED)
RECOVERY mode exit requires the pool to be in Recovery Mode; enableRecoveryMode is permissionless once paused (plan L38) - the core never calls enableRecoveryMode (ASSUMED someone has)
Pool exit returns exactly balancesRaw*bptIn/totalSupply per token (used for the floor window); real V3 rounds and the BPT supply includes a 1e6 minimum-supply reserve (ASSUMED negligible)
hook.recipient set and hook is a phUSD minter (pull must succeed)
The old pooler's donation config (PSM, batchMinter, nudgeStreamer stream registration) remains valid for the new pooler (stream is keyed by batchMinter+gem, not by the pooler; ASSUMED)
